verses.en: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
verses.pt: As palavras do rei Lemuel, rei de Massá, que lhe ensinou sua mãe.
verses.en_web: The words of king Lemuel; the revelation which his mother taught him.
verses.en_bbe: The words of Lemuel, king of Massa: the teaching which he had from his mother.

verses.en: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
verses.pt: Que te direi, filho meu? e que te direi, ó filho do meu ventre? e que te direi, ó filho dos meus votos?
verses.en_web: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
verses.en_bbe: What am I to say to you, O Lemuel, my oldest son? and what, O son of my body? and what, O son of my oaths?

verses.en: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.pt: Não dês às mulheres a tua força, nem os teus caminhos às que destroem os reis.
verses.en_web: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give your strength to women, or your ways to that which is the destruction of kings.

verses.en: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
verses.pt: Não é dos reis, ó Lemuel, não é dos reis beber vinho, nem dos príncipes desejar bebida forte;
verses.en_web: It is not for kings, Lemuel; it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
verses.en_bbe: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to take wine, or for rulers to say, Where is strong drink?

verses.en: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
verses.pt: para que não bebam, e se esqueçam da lei, e pervertam o direito de quem anda aflito.
verses.en_web: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
verses.en_bbe: For fear that through drinking they may come to have no respect for the law, wrongly judging the cause of those who are in trouble.

verses.en: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
verses.pt: Dai bebida forte ao que está para perecer, e o vinho ao que está em amargura de espírito.
verses.en_web: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish; and wine to the bitter in soul:
verses.en_bbe: Give strong drink to him who is near to destruction, and wine to him whose soul is bitter:

verses.en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.pt: Bebam e se esqueçam da sua pobreza, e da sua miséria não se lembrem mais.
verses.en_web: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.en_bbe: Let him have drink, and his need will go from his mind, and the memory of his trouble will be gone.

verses.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.pt: Abre a tua boca a favor do mudo, a favor do direito de todos os desamparados.
verses.en_web: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
verses.en_bbe: Let your mouth be open for those who have no voice, in the cause of those who are ready for death.

verses.en: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.pt: Abre a tua boca; julga retamente, e faze justiça aos pobres e aos necessitados.
verses.en_web: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
verses.en_bbe: Let your mouth be open, judging rightly, and give right decisions in the cause of the poor and those in need.

verses.en: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
verses.pt: Álefe. Mulher virtuosa, quem a pode achar? Pois o seu valor muito excede ao de jóias preciosas.
verses.en_web: Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.
verses.en_bbe: Who may make discovery of a woman of virtue? For her price is much higher than jewels.

verses.en: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
verses.pt: Bete. O coração do seu marido confia nela, e não lhe haverá falta de lucro.
verses.en_web: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
verses.en_bbe: The heart of her husband has faith in her, and he will have profit in full measure.

verses.en: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.pt: Guímel. Ela lhe faz bem, e não mal, todos os dias da sua vida.
verses.en_web: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
verses.en_bbe: She does him good and not evil all the days of her life.

verses.en: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.pt: Dálete. Ela busca lã e linho, e trabalha de boa vontade com as mãos.
verses.en_web: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
verses.en_bbe: She gets wool and linen, working at the business of her hands.

verses.en: She is like the merchants’ ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
verses.pt: Hê. É como os navios do negociante; de longe traz o seu pão.
verses.en_web: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
verses.en_bbe: She is like the trading-ships, getting food from far away.

verses.en: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.pt: Vave. E quando ainda está escuro, ela se levanta, e dá mantimento à sua casa, e a tarefa às suas servas.
verses.en_web: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
verses.en_bbe: She gets up while it is still night, and gives meat to her family, and their food to her servant-girls.

verses.en: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.pt: Zaine. Considera um campo, e compra-o; planta uma vinha com o fruto de suas maos.
verses.en_web: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
verses.en_bbe: After looking at a field with care, she gets it for a price, planting a vine-garden with the profit of her work.

verses.en: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
verses.pt: Hete. Cinge os seus lombos de força, e fortalece os seus braços.
verses.en_web: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
verses.en_bbe: She puts a band of strength round her, and makes her arms strong.

verses.en: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
verses.pt: Tete. Prova e vê que é boa a sua mercadoria; e a sua lâmpada não se apaga de noite.
verses.en_web: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
verses.en_bbe: She sees that her marketing is of profit to her: her light does not go out by night.

verses.en: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
verses.pt: Iode. Estende as mãos ao fuso, e as suas mãos pegam na roca.
verses.en_web: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
verses.en_bbe: She puts her hands to the cloth-working rod, and her fingers take the wheel.

verses.en: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.pt: Cafe. Abre a mão para o pobre; sim, ao necessitado estende as suas mãos.
verses.en_web: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
verses.en_bbe: Her hands are stretched out to the poor; yes, she is open-handed to those who are in need.

verses.en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.pt: Lâmede. Não tem medo da neve pela sua família; pois todos os da sua casa estão vestidos de escarlate.
verses.en_web: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.en_bbe: She has no fear of the snow for her family, for all those in her house are clothed in red.

verses.en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
verses.pt: Meme. Faz para si cobertas; de linho fino e de púrpura é o seu vestido.
verses.en_web: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.en_bbe: She makes for herself cushions of needlework; her clothing is fair linen and purple.

verses.en: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.pt: Nune. Conhece-se o seu marido nas portas, quando se assenta entre os anciãos da terra.
verses.en_web: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
verses.en_bbe: Her husband is a man of note in the public place, when he takes his seat among the responsible men of the land.

verses.en: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.pt: Sâmerue. Faz vestidos de linho, e vende-os, e entrega cintas aos mercadores.
verses.en_web: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
verses.en_bbe: She makes linen robes and gets a price for them, and traders take her cloth bands for a price.

verses.en: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.pt: Aine. A força e a dignidade são os seus vestidos; e ri-se do tempo vindouro.
verses.en_web: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
verses.en_bbe: Strength and self-respect are her clothing; she is facing the future with a smile.

verses.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
verses.pt: Pê. Abre a sua boca com sabedoria, e o ensino da benevolência está na sua língua.
verses.en_web: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Faithful instruction is on her tongue.
verses.en_bbe: Her mouth is open to give out wisdom, and the law of mercy is on her tongue.

verses.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.pt: Tsadê. Olha pelo governo de sua casa, e não come o pão da preguiça.
verses.en_web: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
verses.en_bbe: She gives attention to the ways of her family, she does not take her food without working for it.

verses.en: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
verses.pt: Côfe. Levantam-se seus filhos, e lhe chamam bem-aventurada, como também seu marido, que a louva, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
verses.en_bbe: Her children get up and give her honour, and her husband gives her praise, saying,

verses.en: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
verses.pt: Reche. Muitas mulheres têm procedido virtuosamente, mas tu a todas sobrepujas.
verses.en_web: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
verses.en_bbe: Unnumbered women have done well, but you are better than all of them.

verses.en: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
verses.pt: Chine. Enganosa é a graça, e vã é a formosura; mas a mulher que teme ao Senhor, essa será louvada.
verses.en_web: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
verses.en_bbe: Fair looks are a deceit, and a beautiful form is of no value; but a woman who has the fear of the Lord is to be praised.

verses.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.pt: Tau. Dai-lhe do fruto das suas mãos, e louvem-na nas portas as suas obras.
verses.en_web: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
verses.en_bbe: Give her credit for what her hands have made: let her be praised by her works in the public place.
